ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.document_title: ANNA UNIVERSITY :: CHENNAI - 600 025 | AFFILIATED INSTITUTIONS | REGULATIONS 2017 | CHOICE BASED CREDIT SYSTEM | Common to all B.E. / B.Tech. Full-Time Programmes
ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.regulation: Regulations 2017 (CBCS), Affiliated Institutions, B.E./B.Tech. Full-Time Programmes
ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.locate_phrase: not less than 50% of total marks
ANNA UNIVERSITY|BE-BTECH|2017.passing_criteria: A candidate passes a course by securing not less than 50% of the total marks prescribed for the course (Internal Assessment + End Semester University Examinations) with a minimum of 45% in the End-Semester University Examination; this applies to both theory and practical courses, including project work. For the degree/programme award, the student must successfully gain the required total credits and pass all the subjects prescribed in all 8 semesters within the maximum permitted period.

UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.regulation: University of Delhi Ordinance IX, Article 157: Passing/Promotion Criteria and eligibility for the award of Degree for the Honors and Programme Courses under the Three Year Semester-Scheme
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.clause_heading: 157 Passing/Promotion Criteria and eligibility for the award of Degree for the Honors and Programme Courses under the Three Year Semester-Scheme
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.locate_phrase: A student who has obtained 40% in the aggregate
UNIVERSITY OF DELHI|BACHELOR|2019.passing_criteria: A student must obtain 40% in the aggregate, taking together all papers in theory examination (including internal assessment/project work) and practical examinations separately, up to the end of the sixth semester to be awarded the degree. For promotion, 40% in the aggregate applies for the first and second years, and 50% of papers of the relevant semesters must be passed for year-to-year promotion.

SYMBIOSIS INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY|MBA|2.regulation: III-5.1 Choice Based Credit System (CBCS): Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) System for Academic Programmes
SYMBIOSIS INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY|MBA|2.clause_heading: III-5.1  Choice Based Credit System (CBCS): Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) System for Academic Programmes
SYMBIOSIS INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY|MBA|2.locate_phrase: Passing in a course means securing 40% of absolute
SYMBIOSIS INTERNATIONAL UNIVERSITY|MBA|2.passing_criteria: A student must secure 40% of absolute marks in each head of passing (Continuous Assessment, Term End Examination, and Practical, if applicable). A student is awarded the degree only if they obtain a minimum CGPA of 4.00 on completion of the programme.

IIT KHARAGPUR|BE-BTECH|2022.document_title: UG Rules and Regulations (upto Academic admission batch 2023)
IIT KHARAGPUR|BE-BTECH|2022.regulation: 2022 (B.Tech. Civil Engineering, full-time 4-year programme; cohort admitted under the UG regulations in force)
IIT KHARAGPUR|BE-BTECH|2022.locate_phrase: Obtain a CGPA of 6.00 or higher
IIT KHARAGPUR|BE-BTECH|2022.passing_criteria: For a course, the regulation uses a 7-scale grading system in which the pass grade is P with grade point 5, while F is fail. For programme completion, a student must complete all degree credit requirements and obtain a CGPA of 6.00 or higher at the end of the semester in which all degree requirements are completed.

IGNOU|BE-BTECH|2007.document_title: Appendix-1 (to Resolution No. AC 8.3.3) — Amendment to Clause 5(1) of the Ordinance on Conduct of Examinations and Evaluation of Student Performance
IGNOU|BE-BTECH|2007.regulation: IGNOU Academic Council resolution AC 8.3.3 (Appendix-1), not a 2007 B.Tech-specific regulation
IGNOU|BE-BTECH|2007.clause_heading: Amendment to Clause 5 (1) of the Ordinance on Conduct of Examinations and Evaluation of Student Performance
IGNOU|BE-BTECH|2007.locate_phrase: overall average of grade 'C' in the relevant course
IGNOU|BE-BTECH|2007.passing_criteria: Except for the Bachelor's degree programmes of B.A., B.Com., and B.Sc., a student must obtain an overall average of grade 'C' in the relevant course to complete the course and qualify for the relevant degree/diploma/certificate. The student must not obtain a grade lower than 'D' either in continuous evaluation or in term-end examination.
